measurement_protocol.build_pipeline: clang frontend without LLVM passes; opt default<O3>; recursively extract bench_kernel with constant initializers; clang backend
measurement_protocol.harness: loop-benchmarks rvv_main.c schema_version=2, preloaded kernel mode

measurement.aggregation_within_run: sum of measured repetitions; see benchmarks.workload_json
measurement.boundary: fence; rdcycle before bench_kernel; fence; rdcycle after bench_kernel
measurement.excluded: input preparation, reset, observation, startup and result printing
measurement.included_overhead: counter reads, fences, and kernel call

representative_selection.eligibility: status=succeeded, exit_code=0, measurement_status=complete, kernel_status=available; exactly one complete positive integer kernel_cycle sample
representative_selection.rule: latest successful attempt by greatest attempt_no for each benchmark and scalable VF
representative_selection.variants: normal-scalable-vfN only; scalar, automatic and fission excluded

measurement_protocol.source_adaptation: Expand local fixture includes and rename the bench_kernel identifier to selected_kernel; preserve bodies and source language.
measurement_protocol.vf_semantics: scalable vectorization coefficient: vf=N means sN; vf=1 is s1, not scalar
measurement_protocol.workload_metadata: runtime JSON where measured; kernel-mode defaults (1 repetition, 0 warmups) otherwise
